Reference / runtime/account

runtime/account#

The native layer under os/account: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under os/account: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native account_current_user#

native account_current_user() is %string:string

Portable immutable account lookup boundary. Identity strings are opaque to the language and may contain a UID, SID or another provider representation.

native account_user_named#

native account_user_named(name is string) is %string:string

The account called name: id, group, home, shell; empty when none.

native account_group_named#

native account_group_named(name is string) is %string:string

The group called name: id; empty when none.

native account_group_users#

native account_group_users(name is string) is @string

The members of the group called name.
